text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth customer spotlight. Need to lock interview time, record permissions, and a short quote approval flow by next Wed. Anyone with constraints?
Ryan: I can take lead on interview guide + asset list. Prefer 30m + 10m buffer for mic checks.
Tess: Sara from NovaHealth said mornings PDT work best. Avoid Tue after 2pm — all-hands for them.
Lina: I can do a quick brand photo if they want headshots; we’ll need release signed.
Aisha: Great. Sam — legal: do we need a special NDA or is the standard release enough for quote usage across web + webinar?
Sam: Standard customer release covers case study and promo. If they want redlines to the quote, we need a one-week review window. Flag any PHI?
Tess: No PHI. They handle de-identified datasets. So normal release should be fine.
Noah: For leads — planning a webinar with NovaHealth included in promo. Can we route registrations to AE queue `inbound-nova` and tag MQLs to the healthcare segment?
Aisha: Yes, route to `inbound-nova`. Ryan, can you add lead-tagging instructions to the campaign doc?
Ryan: Will do. Adding snippet to the doc now:
```
Leads: route -> inbound-nova
Tags: industry:healthcare, source:novahc-spotlight, campaign:mar-spotlight
Notify: #sales-ops + Noah
```
Lina: Quick question on assets — do we need b-roll or product screens? I can capture lightweight screen grabs but need access to their console.
Sara (NovaHealth): We can provide a 5-minute screen recording and headshot. Happy to sign release; one small legal redline about anonymizing patient IDs in screenshots.
Sam: Noted. Anonymize screenshots; we’ll add a clause in the release confirming redaction responsibility on NovaHealth's side and that Redwood will not publish raw PHI.
Aisha: Timeline check:
- Confirm interview time by EOD Fri
- Interview recorded next week (week of Mar 30)
- Draft case study + quote sent to Sara for approval within 4 business days post-interview
- Legal review of any redlines done within 3 business days of receiving edits
Ryan: I'll draft the quote copy to be one short paragraph — keep it editable.
Tess: I'll coordinate scheduling and collect the release signature via DocuSign.
Noah: I'll set up the `inbound-nova` queue and rule in HubSpot. Send me the campaign tag values once final.
Lina: I'll prep imagery guidelines and a Slack checklist for the day-of: mic, backgrounds, logo frames.
Sam: One more — if they want to review the live webinar slides, give legal a 24hr heads-up.
Aisha: Perfect. Owners: Ryan (case copy), Tess (scheduling + release), Sam (legal), Lina (assets), Noah (lead routing). Ryan, please post the interview guide link here when ready.
Ryan: Posted: https://docs.redwood.dev/marketing/novahc-interview-guide — PTAL.
Tess: Scheduling poll sent to Sara.
Sara (NovaHealth): Got it — filled out 9am PT next Wed. Looking forward to it!
Aisha: :tada: Solid. Follow-ups: Ryan will draft quote within 4 days, Sam will confirm release clause language, Noah will confirm HubSpot routing. Thanks team.
